title: ResNet34d, 600 epochs, recipe R (train 224)
summary: ResNet34d 600 ep, 224 train; OOF up to 0.836 at inference 320
hypothesis: ResNet34d with the longer schedule that helped ResNet18 should improve.
findings: Training schedule plus inference at 288-352 gives +0.03 OOF over 224 inference.
limitations: Inference-resolution sweep chosen on the same OOF.
